title: STAR-T-GATE Inbox #13 repository self-audit disposition

dispositions.notes: Fresh-current-main reconciliation changes the original audit materially. The former S4 shared-parameter identifier is intentionally preserved as a legacy_id on the canonical S8 registry. The claimed truncated Inventor/Revit W6 relationship is stale: current S9 exchange standard and instruction both resolve to TIVERIT-BIM-WF-W6.3-INVENTOR-REVIT-EXPORT-001, which exists. ROLE-BIM-COORDINATOR-001 and ROLE-BIM-MANAGER-001 are intentional superseded identifiers mapped by REG-ROLE-RESOLUTION-001 to the current project-scoped roles, not missing role authority. REG-PARAM and REG-TOOL in the BIM Director output were genuine placeholder labels; this branch repairs them to TIVERIT-BIM-STD-S8-SP-REG-001 and REG-S9-TOOL-AUTHORITY-001. Remaining reference-integrity work should be validator-driven rather than copied from the stale audit.

The audit correctly identified two ATS linkage conventions. The schema now requires governing_object_id on every ATS. The ten requirement-only ATS retain requirement_id as their bounded secondary locator and now also identify their canonical parent governing object. A dedicated CI validator resolves every ATS governing_object_id and any requirement_id against the canonical ID graph. This changes conformance linkage only and does not alter the underlying normative requirements.

Incomplete ATS/ETS coverage is expected during staged maturity, but silent coverage is undesirable. Record a coverage inventory; do not require every instruction to have executable conformance where human verification is legitimate.

ISO 19650-5/security-minded governance must not be invented from the Inbox. Route through the external-standard authority model being considered in Inbox #11, then either declare an explicit boundary or create a governed TIVERIT security requirement through normal authority review.
The corpus needs a citable release/version model before formal cutover. This is repository governance, not domain doctrine. Define release semantics separately from per-object migration status.
Absence of explicit licensing/contribution terms is a real publication/adoption risk. Curator must not select a license on behalf of the owner. Record and escalate for owner decision.

Operational-phase coverage must be declared as in-scope future work or explicit non-goal. Do not infer ISO 19650-3 requirements into the normative corpus until external-standard applicability and TIVERIT scope are governed.
Verify the claimed ETS identifier and role-resolution-map classification against current main, then repair or relocate only where repository architecture supports the change.

curator_rule: Inbox evidence remains non-authoritative. Mechanical repairs may be promoted when they preserve existing authority; new external-standard, scope, licensing or release authority requires explicit governed decisions.
